name: opencode-jev-permissions
description: OpenCode V2 server permission proxy evaluated by TypeSafe Jev (once/reject/manual).

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc src/index.ts --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --lib ES2022,DOM --types node --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --noImplicitOverride --noFallthroughCasesInSwitch --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters --forceConsistentCasingInFileNames --isolatedModules --verbatimModuleSyntax --skipLibCheck --outDir dist --declaration --declarationMap --sourceMap
scripts.verify: node -e 'const [a,b,c]=process.versions.node.split(".").map(Number); if (a<22 || (a===22 && (b<19 || (b===19 && c<0)))) process.exit(1)' && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
